provenance.what_still_needs_fleet_hardware: A quiet machine with a live RAPL domain (or a whole-board rail) for CPU joules; an NVIDIA GPU with libnvidia-ml.so.1 for GPU joules; an Apple silicon host with macmon on PATH for the SoC counter. energy.macos_policy: macOS power, when that OS is the host, is ferrotherm_meter::Meter::macmon (rootless IOReport via the macmon binary). This harness has no other macOS path.
energy.note: Evidence grade contended host. Each trial repeats the sampler for at least 2 s and reports joules per repetition. Attribution needs 8 counter updates in that window. Summaries are per workload. RAPL package and macmon whole-system are not combined. These figures are not quiet-host evidence. load1 and other-process CPU are on every trial. RAPL on framework-128gb-0000 reads package energy_uj without root and is the primary instrument. macmon is secondary.

workloads.source: Finite open 2D Ising, the lattice both codebases sample (ferrotherm::ising::grid2d; THRML IsingEBM). 3x3 rather than 4x4 so a few thousand draws can resolve total variation. Not Onsager's infinite lattice, and not a Z1-topology graph.

workloads.source: Potts interaction as in Extropic's codon-optimisation note (https://docs.thrml.ai/en/latest/papers/codon-optimization/) and arXiv:2510.23972 Appendix C.1.1, reduced to an enumerable path. ferrotherm::potts heat-bath, index order; THRML one node per block in that order.

workloads.source: arXiv:2608.01615 §IV.4 and Appendix J.3, reduced from d=12 to d=8 so a histogram of a few thousand draws can be compared with the exact law. 12 pairs, 10 triples, weights i.i.d. N(0, 0.6^2). The paper does not publish the draw seed; this pin uses ferrotherm::rng::Pcg::new(260801615, 0x54535031), Box-Muller, and rejection-sampled Fisher-Yates. Native chromatic Gibbs of the three-body energy, not Figure 12.
